NIA arrests deported suspect in Punjab railway blast case

The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has arrested a key accused in the Punjab railway line blast case, who was deported from the US. This arrest brings the total number of individuals held in connection with the case to eight. The arrested individual is described as a supporter of the Khalistan Zindabad Force (KZF).
